AI BIJAN Motion - packed source files of this folder. Do not edit by hand.
The skill upload in the Claude app accepts at most 200 files, so the source files are packed here.
`node <skill folder>/new-project.mjs <project folder> --kit=<style>` unpacks them into the project.
Format: per file one line with four '=' signs, the byte length and the path, then exactly that many bytes.

==== 2394 project/src/worlds/kos/Kos.tsx
// Kos world, picture side: the EP01 boarding-house set driven by the story's set state, plus the moonlit
// atmosphere (shafts through the small window and the bedroom window, dust).

import React from "react";
import { Dust, Shaft } from "../../cine/FX.tsx";
import type { Cam } from "../../cine/types.ts";
import type { SetState, V3 } from "../types.ts";
import { Kos, type KosState } from "./set/Kos.tsx";
import { Exterior } from "./set/Exterior.tsx";
import { MOON } from "./looks.ts";
import { ROOM, ROOM_WIN, SMALL_WIN, WALL } from "./layout.ts";

const into: V3 = [-MOON[0], -MOON[1], -MOON[2]];
const SMALL_CORNERS: V3[] = [[SMALL_WIN.x - 0.1, SMALL_WIN.y0, SMALL_WIN.z0], [SMALL_WIN.x - 0.1, SMALL_WIN.y0, SMALL_WIN.z1], [SMALL_WIN.x - 0.1, SMALL_WIN.y1, SMALL_WIN.z1], [SMALL_WIN.x - 0.1, SMALL_WIN.y1, SMALL_WIN.z0]];
const RX = ROOM.x0 - WALL / 2;
const ROOM_CORNERS: V3[] = [[RX, ROOM_WIN.y0, ROOM_WIN.z0], [RX, ROOM_WIN.y0, ROOM_WIN.z1], [RX, ROOM_WIN.y1, ROOM_WIN.z1], [RX, ROOM_WIN.y1, ROOM_WIN.z0]];

export const KosSet: React.FC<{ place: string; time: string; s: SetState; t: number; cam: Cam }> = ({ place, time, s, t }) => {
  const day = time === "day";
  const vent = s.vent ?? 0;
  const k: KosState = {
    roomDoor: (s.door ?? 0) * 1.55, key: 0, lever: 0,
    vent: 0.004 * Math.sin(t * 3.1) + vent * 0.22 * Math.max(0, Math.sin(t * 9.4)) ** 6,
    tubes: s.tubes ?? 0, led: Math.floor(t) % 2 === 0 ? 1 : 0.2, colon: Math.floor(t * 2) % 2 === 0,
    fan: t * Math.PI * 2 * 3.3 * (s.fan ?? 1), coat: 0.012 * Math.sin(t * 0.9), coatOn: (s.coat ?? 1) > 0.5,
    room: true, hall: true, roof: true, gudang: s.gudang ?? 0, pile: (s.pile ?? 0) > 0.5, day,
  };
  const hall = place === "hall";
  return (
    <group>
      <Kos s={k} />
      <Exterior visible={place === "yard" || day} lamp={day ? 0 : 1} day={day} roof />
      <Shaft corners={SMALL_CORNERS} dir={into} len={2.6} spread={0.3} color="#9fb8ff" i={hall && !day && (s.tubes ?? 0) < 0.5 ? 0.05 : 0} />
      <Shaft corners={ROOM_CORNERS} dir={into} len={2.8} spread={0.2} color={day ? "#fff2d8" : "#9fb8ff"} i={place === "room" ? 0.07 : 0} />
      <Dust min={[-0.78, 0.15, -15.0]} max={[0.78, 2.7, -11.5]} n={260} t={t} i={hall ? 0.32 : 0} size={0.01} />
      <Dust min={[-4.2, 0.2, -6.6]} max={[-2.0, 2.6, -4.4]} n={160} t={t} i={place === "room" ? 0.28 : 0} size={0.009} seed={9} />
    </group>
  );
};

==== 4198 project/src/worlds/kos/layout.ts
// Kos world (from Dunia Nabel EP01): one coordinate module for the boarding house — the kos plan, every story-critical prop, character marks.
// Geometry, performances, cameras and the Act 5 reveal all read these numbers, so the building never
// changes between the mystery and the reveal. Units metres, y up. The hallway runs along −Z from the
// entrance (z = ENTRANCE_Z) to the end wall (z = END_Z); the hallway centre line is x = 0.

export type V3 = [number, number, number];


export const CEIL = 2.8;
export const HALL = { x0: -0.8, x1: 0.8, z0: 1.0, z1: -15.0 };
export const ENTRANCE_Z = HALL.z0;
export const END_Z = HALL.z1;
export const WALL = 0.15;

export type Door = { id: string; side: -1 | 1; z: number; w: number; h: number; label: string; hinge: -1 | 1 };
/** Room doors on the hallway walls (side −1 = left wall x = −0.8, +1 = right wall). `hinge` = which z end. */
export const DOORS: Door[] = [
  { id: "K1", side: -1, z: -2.0, w: 0.82, h: 2.05, label: "1", hinge: 1 },
  { id: "K2", side: -1, z: -5.5, w: 0.82, h: 2.05, label: "2", hinge: 1 },
  { id: "K3", side: -1, z: -9.0, w: 0.82, h: 2.05, label: "3", hinge: 1 },
  { id: "K5", side: 1, z: -3.5, w: 0.82, h: 2.05, label: "5", hinge: 1 },
  { id: "K6", side: 1, z: -7.0, w: 0.82, h: 2.05, label: "6", hinge: 1 },
  { id: "K7", side: 1, z: -10.5, w: 0.82, h: 2.05, label: "7", hinge: 1 },
  { id: "K8", side: 1, z: -13.6, w: 0.82, h: 2.05, label: "8", hinge: 1 },
];
export const ROOM_DOOR = DOORS[1];
export const EMPTY_ROOM_DOOR = DOORS[6];

/** the bedroom (K2) interior box. Door on its +X wall (the hallway wall). */
export const ROOM = { x0: -4.3, x1: HALL.x0, z0: -7.2, z1: -3.8 };
export const ROOM_WIN = { z0: -6.2, z1: -4.8, y0: 0.95, y1: 2.15 }; // on the outer wall x = ROOM.x0
export const BED = { x0: -4.25, x1: -2.25, z0: -7.15, z1: -6.2, top: 0.46 };
export const DESK = { x0: -3.75, x1: -2.55, z: -3.85, d: 0.55, top: 0.74 };
export const CLOCK: V3 = [-2.68, DESK.top, -4.17];
export const CLOCK_YAW = 0.42;
export const BOTTLE: V3 = [-3.08, DESK.top, -4.24];
export const FAN: V3 = [-3.95, 0, -5.3];
export const WARDROBE = { x0: -1.95, x1: -0.95, z: -7.15, d: 0.55, h: 1.95 };
export const SOCKET: V3 = [-4.3 + 0.012, 0.32, -4.25];
/** Key in the lock on the room side of the bedroom door (door closed). */
export const KEY: V3 = [HALL.x0 - WALL - 0.035, 0.955, ROOM_DOOR.z - ROOM_DOOR.w / 2 + 0.1];
/** Door handle (latch side), hallway face. */
export const HANDLE_Z = ROOM_DOOR.z - ROOM_DOOR.w / 2 + 0.085;

/** The end of the hallway: gudang door in the end wall, the vent above it, the raincoat on its hook. */
export const GUDANG = { x: 0.22, w: 0.8, h: 2.0 };
export const VENT = { x: GUDANG.x, y0: 2.18, y1: 2.5, w: 0.56 };
/** Hook position on the end wall; the raincoat hangs from here (hood up). */
export const RAINCOAT_HOOK: V3 = [-0.5, 2.0, END_Z + 0.02];
/** Small high window on the left wall near the end, opening onto the side passage (motorbike light enters here). */
export const SMALL_WIN = { x: HALL.x0, z0: -14.45, z1: -13.95, y0: 1.72, y1: 2.22 };
/** Water dispenser against the right wall between K7 and K8. */
export const DISPENSER: V3 = [HALL.x1 - 0.22, 0, -12.05];
/** Left rooms K1–K3 end here; beyond it, outside the left wall, an open side passage (gang samping). */
export const LEFT_ROOMS_END = -10.8;
export const PASSAGE = { x0: -3.4, x1: HALL.x0 - WALL, z0: LEFT_ROOMS_END, z1: END_Z - 1.2 };

/** Ceiling tube lamps (off at night) and the CCTV camera at the entrance. */
export const TUBES: V3[] = [[0, CEIL - 0.03, -4.0], [0, CEIL - 0.03, -10.0]];
export const CCTV: V3 = [0.6, 2.42, 0.25];
export const CCTV_LOOK: V3 = [-0.1, 0.6, -13.5];

/** Outside. Terrace + yard at the entrance side, gate further out; side alley along the left. */
export const TERRACE_LAMP: V3 = [0.95, 2.55, 1.6];
export const YARD = { z0: 1.0, z1: 6.5, x0: -4.6, x1: 4.6 };
export const GATE = { z: 6.5, x0: -1.4, x1: 1.4, h: 1.75 };
export const ALLEY_X = -6.2;
export const STREET_LAMP: V3 = [5.6, 4.2, 8.4];

/** Character marks in the hallway (Act 1). */
export const MARK_STOP: [number, number] = [0.08, -7.6];
export const MARK_CREEP: [number, number] = [0.04, -8.6];

==== 10920 project/src/worlds/kos/looks.ts
// Light + grade presets per location/mood for episode 01. Mystery = deep blue ambient, warm practical
// from the terrace behind the hero, cold moon from ahead; never crushed (lifted blue shadows).

import { GRADE0, type Grade } from "../../cine/types.ts";
import { P_OFF, S_OFF, type LightState, type PointL, type SpotL } from "../../cine/types.ts";
import { CLOCK, END_Z, GUDANG, ENTRANCE_Z, HALL, ROOM_DOOR, ROOM, SMALL_WIN, STREET_LAMP, TERRACE_LAMP, type V3 } from "./layout.ts";

const box = (min: V3, max: V3) => ({ min, max });

/** Moon direction (toward the moon): from the left (−x), high, slightly in front (+z). */
export const MOON: V3 = [-0.37, 0.61, 0.69];

/** Terrace lamp as a shadow spot pointing down the hallway (warm, from behind the hero). */
export const TERRACE_SPOT: SpotL = {
  pos: [TERRACE_LAMP[0] - 0.6, TERRACE_LAMP[1] - 0.15, TERRACE_LAMP[2] - 0.1], target: [0, 0.2, -9], color: "#ffb36a", i: 22, angle: 0.62, penumbra: 0.8, dist: 24,
};

const clockGlow: PointL = { pos: [CLOCK[0] + 0.03, CLOCK[1] + 0.06, CLOCK[2] - 0.08], color: "#ff3b2a", i: 0.035, dist: 0.7 };

export const L_ROOM: LightState = {
  bg: "#04070d", fog: { color: "#0a1222", density: 0.02 }, env: 0.06,
  hemi: { sky: "#3d5585", ground: "#120e0c", i: 0.32 },
  moon: { dir: MOON, color: "#8fb0ff", i: 4.2, box: box([ROOM.x0 - 0.3, -0.1, ROOM.z0 - 0.2], [ROOM.x1 + 0.2, 2.9, ROOM.z1 + 0.2]) },
  spots: [S_OFF, S_OFF],
  pts: [
    clockGlow,
    { pos: [-2.9, 1.4, -6.1], color: "#5c78b6", i: 0.9, dist: 4 }, // bounce off the moonlit floor
    { pos: [HALL.x0 - 0.3, 0.12, ROOM_DOOR.z], color: "#ffb36a", i: 0.25, dist: 1.6 }, // warm sliver under the door
    { pos: [-1.6, 2.2, -4.4], color: "#3a4d78", i: 0.5, dist: 4 },
    P_OFF, P_OFF,
  ],
};

export const L_HALL: LightState = {
  bg: "#04070d", fog: { color: "#0b1426", density: 0.045 }, env: 0.05,

  ],
};

/** Exterior establishing: moon, terrace lamp, street sodium lamp. */

/** Motorbike headlight passing in the side passage, beam through the small window (u: 0..1 pass). */
export const bikeLight = (u: number): SpotL => {
  const k = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, u));
  const env = Math.sin(Math.PI * k);
  const zc = (SMALL_WIN.z0 + SMALL_WIN.z1) / 2;
  // through the window toward the end wall behind the raincoat: the patch (and the coat's shadow) slide
  return {
    pos: [-2.7, 2.5, zc + 2.4 - 2.2 * k],
    target: [-0.3, 1.45, END_Z],
    color: "#f4f1ff", i: 70 * env, angle: 0.3, penumbra: 0.45, dist: 9,
  };
};

export const G_NIGHT: Grade = {
  ...GRADE0, exposure: 1.5, lift: [0.02, 0.03, 0.058], gain: [0.96, 1.0, 1.07], sat: 0.9, contrast: 1.05,
  vignette: 0.36, grain: 0.024, bloom: 0.32, bloomRadius: 0.55, bloomThreshold: 0.92, ca: 0.0016,
};
export const G_EXT: Grade = { ...G_NIGHT, exposure: 1.0, sat: 0.9, vignette: 0.34 };

==== 13782 project/src/worlds/kos/set/End.tsx
// The end of the hallway — every element of the mystery lives here from the first frame and is reused
// unchanged in the Act 5 reveal: the end wall + gudang door, the vent with its loose flap (the three
// knocks), the long black raincoat on its hook (the "figure"), the small window onto the side passage
// (the motorbike light), the water dispenser, the empty room K8 (door in Kos.tsx).

import React, { useMemo } from "react";
import { BufferGeometry, DoubleSide, LatheGeometry, Vector2 } from "three";
import { box, cached, cyl, sphere, torus } from "../../../kits/worldforge/geo.ts";
import { basic, phys } from "../../../cine/mats.ts";
import { mulberry32 } from "../../../kits/worldforge/noise.ts";
import { CEIL, DISPENSER, END_Z, GUDANG, HALL, LEFT_ROOMS_END, PASSAGE, RAINCOAT_HOOK, SMALL_WIN, VENT, WALL } from "../layout.ts";
import { HoledWall, MAT, Slab } from "./parts.tsx";
import { plankDoorTex } from "../../../cine/set/tex.ts";
import type { KosState } from "./Kos.tsx";

const EW = END_Z - WALL / 2; // end wall centre

export const coatMat = () => phys("raincoat", { color: "#0d0e12", roughness: 0.32, clearcoat: 0.7, clearcoatRoughness: 0.18, sheen: 0.2, sheenColor: "#4a5570" });

/** Long raincoat body: lathe from shoulders to hem with vertical folds, flattened front-to-back. */
export const coatBody = () =>
  cached("coatBody", () => {
    const pts: Vector2[] = [];
    const prof: [number, number][] = [[0.0, -0.22], [0.13, -0.235], [0.215, -0.29], [0.235, -0.36], [0.24, -0.6], [0.255, -0.95], [0.285, -1.35], [0.33, -1.7], [0.335, -1.74], [0.31, -1.745]];
    for (const [r, y] of prof) pts.push(new Vector2(r, y));
    const g: BufferGeometry = new LatheGeometry(pts, 72);
    const a = g.attributes.position;
    for (let i = 0; i < a.count; i++) {
      const x = a.getX(i), y = a.getY(i), z = a.getZ(i);
      const ang = Math.atan2(z, x);
      const k = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (-y - 0.4) / 1.3));
      const fold = 1 + k * (0.05 * Math.sin(ang * 7 + 0.6) + 0.03 * Math.sin(ang * 13 + 2.1));
      // flatten the back against the wall
      const zz = z < 0 ? z * 0.42 : z * 0.62;
      a.setXYZ(i, x * fold, y, zz * fold);
    }
    g.computeVertexNormals();
    return g;
  });

/** Hood: an ellipsoid shell, front opening facing +z. */
export const hoodGeo = () =>
  cached("hood", () => {
    const g = new LatheGeometry(
      [[0.0, -0.17], [0.07, -0.16], [0.115, -0.11], [0.135, -0.03], [0.13, 0.05], [0.1, 0.11], [0.05, 0.14], [0.0, 0.145]].map(([r, y]) => new Vector2(r, y)),
      48,
    );
    const a = g.attributes.position;
    for (let i = 0; i < a.count; i++) {
      const x = a.getX(i), y = a.getY(i), z = a.getZ(i);
      // pointed peak at the back-top, deeper forward brim
      a.setXYZ(i, x, y + (z < 0 ? -z * 0.25 : 0), z * 1.08 + (y > 0 ? 0.02 : 0));
    }
    g.computeVertexNormals();
    return g;
  });

/** The "figure": hood (dark void face), cords + flap strips hanging like hair, shoulders, sleeves. */
const Raincoat: React.FC<{ sway: number }> = ({ sway }) => {
  const m = coatMat();
  const strands = useMemo(() => {
    const r = mulberry32(19);
    return Array.from({ length: 11 }, (_, i) => {
      const x = -0.085 + (i / 10) * 0.17 + (r() - 0.5) * 0.02;
      return { x, len: 0.26 + r() * 0.22, w: 0.012 + r() * 0.016, rz: (r() - 0.5) * 0.12, z: 0.11 + Math.cos((x / 0.09) * 1.2) * 0.035 };
    });
  }, []);
  return (
    <group position={RAINCOAT_HOOK}>
      {/* hook + loop */}
      <mesh geometry={cyl(0.006, 0.006, 0.07, 8)} material={MAT.steel()} position={[0, 0.0, 0.035]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} />
      <mesh geometry={torus(0.018, 0.004, 6, 16)} material={m} position={[0, -0.005, 0.07]} />
      <group position={[0, -0.02, 0.15]} rotation={[sway, 0, sway * 0.6]}>
        {/* hood */}
        <group position={[0, -0.13, 0]} rotation={[0.18, 0, 0]}>
          <mesh geometry={hoodGeo()} material={m} castShadow receiveShadow />
          <mesh geometry={sphere(0.1, 24, 16)} material={basic("void", { color: "#000000" })} position={[0, -0.03, 0.06]} scale={[0.82, 1.05, 0.55]} />
          <mesh geometry={torus(0.1, 0.014, 8, 32, Math.PI * 1.25)} material={m} position={[0, -0.02, 0.085]} rotation={[0.1, 0, -Math.PI * 0.125 + Math.PI / 2 - Math.PI * 0.5]} scale={[0.86, 1.12, 1]} castShadow />
          {/* flap strips + cords hanging over the opening: the "long hair" */}
          {strands.map((s, i) => (
            <mesh key={i} geometry={box(s.w, s.len, 0.004, 0.002)} material={m} position={[s.x, 0.06 - s.len / 2, s.z]} rotation={[0.06, 0, s.rz]} castShadow />
          ))}
          {[-0.045, 0.045].map((x) => (
            <mesh key={x} geometry={cyl(0.003, 0.003, 0.42, 6)} material={phys("cord", { color: "#15161a", roughness: 0.6 })} position={[x, -0.25, 0.115]} castShadow />
          ))}
        </group>
        {/* body */}
        <mesh geometry={coatBody()} material={m} position={[0, 0.02, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />
        {/* placket with snaps */}
        <mesh geometry={box(0.035, 1.38, 0.01, 0.004)} material={m} position={[0, -1.03, 0.155]} rotation={[-0.045, 0, 0]} castShadow />
        {[0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map((k) => (
          <mesh key={k} geometry={cyl(0.007, 0.007, 0.004, 10)} material={phys("snap", { color: "#3b3e44", metalness: 0.8, roughness: 0.4 })} position={[0, -0.45 - k * 0.27, 0.163 + k * 0.012]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} />
        ))}
        {/* sleeves hanging from the shoulders */}
        {[1, -1].map((s) => (
          <group key={s} position={[s * 0.215, -0.31, 0.02]} rotation={[0.05, 0, s * 0.07]}>
            <mesh geometry={cyl(0.06, 0.074, 0.72, 20)} material={m} position={[0, -0.36, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />
            <mesh geometry={cyl(0.058, 0.058, 0.01, 20)} material={basic("void", { color: "#000000" })} position={[0, -0.72, 0]} />
          </group>
        ))}
      </group>
    </group>
  );
};

/** Vent above the gudang door: fixed louvres, a hinged loose flap (rotates about its top edge). */
const Vent: React.FC<{ flap: number }> = ({ flap }) => {

      <Slab min={[-w / 2 - 0.03, -h / 2, -0.02]} max={[-w / 2, h / 2, 0.025]} m={fr} />

==== 11004 project/src/worlds/kos/set/Exterior.tsx
// Outside the kos: night sky (gradient dome, stars, moon), the front facade with dark windows, terrace
// with the one lamp still on, yard with parked scooters, the locked gate, the street, neighbours.

import React, { useMemo } from "react";
import { BackSide, BufferAttribute, BufferGeometry, Color, DoubleSide, ShaderMaterial } from "three";
import { box, cached, cyl, sphere, torus } from "../../../kits/worldforge/geo.ts";
import { basic, phys } from "../../../cine/mats.ts";
import { mulberry32 } from "../../../kits/worldforge/noise.ts";
import { CEIL, ENTRANCE_Z, GATE, HALL, ROOM, STREET_LAMP, TERRACE_LAMP, WALL, YARD, type V3 } from "../layout.ts";
import { MAT, Slab } from "./parts.tsx";

let skyM: ShaderMaterial | null = null;
const skyMat = () =>
  (skyM ??= new ShaderMaterial({
    side: BackSide,
    depthWrite: false,
    fog: false,
    uniforms: { top: { value: new Color("#060b18") }, horizon: { value: new Color("#1d2d4c") }, glow: { value: new Color("#3a4f78") } },
    vertexShader: /* glsl */ `varying vec3 vP; void main(){ vP = normalize(position); gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
    fragmentShader: /* glsl */ `uniform vec3 top; uniform vec3 horizon; uniform vec3 glow; varying vec3 vP;
      void main(){ float h = clamp(vP.y, 0.0, 1.0); vec3 c = mix(horizon, top, pow(h, 0.55));
        float m = max(0.0, dot(vP, normalize(vec3(-0.45, 0.42, 0.78))));
        c += glow * pow(m, 18.0) * 0.6;
        gl_FragColor = vec4(c, 1.0); }`,
  }));

let dayM: ShaderMaterial | null = null;
const daySky = () =>
  (dayM ??= new ShaderMaterial({
    side: BackSide, depthWrite: false, fog: false,
    uniforms: {},
    vertexShader: /* glsl */ `varying vec3 vP; void main(){ vP = normalize(position); gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
    fragmentShader: /* glsl */ `varying vec3 vP; void main(){ float h = clamp(vP.y, 0.0, 1.0);
      vec3 c = mix(vec3(0.93, 0.88, 0.80), vec3(0.47, 0.66, 0.88), pow(h, 0.5)); gl_FragColor = vec4(c, 1.0); }`,
  }));

export const Sky: React.FC<{ day?: boolean }> = ({ day = false }) => {
  const stars = useMemo(
    () =>
      cached("stars", () => {
        const r = mulberry32(5);
        const n = 700, pos = new Float32Array(n * 3);
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          const a = r() * Math.PI * 2, e = 0.12 + Math.pow(r(), 0.7) * 1.3;
          pos.set([Math.cos(a) * Math.cos(e) * 180, Math.sin(e) * 180, Math.sin(a) * Math.cos(e) * 180], i * 3);
        }
        const g = new BufferGeometry();
        g.setAttribute("position", new BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
        return g;
      }),
    [],
  );
  return (
    <group>
      <mesh geometry={sphere(200, 32, 16)} material={day ? daySky() : skyMat()} renderOrder={-10} />
      <points geometry={stars} visible={!day}>
        <pointsMaterial color="#cdd8ff" size={1.3} sizeAttenuation={false} fog={false} transparent opacity={0.8} depthWrite={false} />
      </points>
      <mesh geometry={sphere(3.2, 24, 16)} material={basic("moon", { color: "#e9eeff", fog: false })} position={[-0.45 * 170, 0.42 * 170, 0.78 * 170]} visible={!day} />
    </group>
  );
};

/** Scooter (parked), simplified but readable: wheels, body, seat, handlebar, mirror. */
export const Scooter: React.FC<{ p: V3; yaw: number; c: string }> = ({ p, yaw, c }) => {
  const body = phys(`scoot${c}`, { color: c, roughness: 0.3, clearcoat: 0.8, metalness: 0.1 });
  const tyre = MAT.matte("#141414", 0.9);
  return (
    <group position={p} rotation={[0, yaw, 0.06]}>
      {[0.62, -0.6].map((z) => (
        <group key={z} position={[0, 0.25, z]}>
          <mesh geometry={torus(0.19, 0.06, 10, 28)} material={tyre} rotation={[0, Math.PI / 2, 0]} castShadow />
          <mesh geometry={cyl(0.12, 0.12, 0.06, 18)} material={MAT.steel()} rotation={[0, 0, Math.PI / 2]} />
        </group>
      ))}
      <mesh geometry={box(0.32, 0.36, 0.9, 0.12)} material={body} position={[0, 0.52, -0.28]} castShadow receiveShadow />
      <mesh geometry={box(0.28, 0.12, 0.62, 0.05)} material={MAT.matte("#1a1a1c", 0.6)} position={[0, 0.76, -0.3]} castShadow />
      <mesh geometry={box(0.3, 0.12, 0.5, 0.04)} material={body} position={[0, 0.3, 0.2]} castShadow />
      <mesh geometry={box(0.3, 0.75, 0.16, 0.08)} material={body} position={[0, 0.66, 0.52]} rotation={[-0.25, 0, 0]} castShadow />
      <mesh geometry={cyl(0.016, 0.016, 0.7, 8)} material={MAT.matte("#222", 0.5)} position={[0, 1.08, 0.58]} rotation={[0, 0, Math.PI / 2]} castShadow />
      <mesh geometry={box(0.2, 0.12, 0.08, 0.04)} material={phys("headlampGlass", { color: "#cfd8e0", roughness: 0.1, clearcoat: 1 })} position={[0, 0.98, 0.66]} />
    </group>
  );
};

const Gate: React.FC = () => {
  const iron = phys("iron", { color: "#20252b", metalness: 0.6, roughness: 0.5 });
  const n = 18;
  return (
    <group position={[0, 0, GATE.z]}>
      {[GATE.x0 - 0.12, GATE.x1 + 0.12].map((x) => (
        <Slab key={x} min={[x - 0.15, 0, -0.15]} max={[x + 0.15, GATE.h + 0.25, 0.15]} m={MAT.matte("#6b6a66", 0.95)} />
      ))}
      {/* fence walls left and right */}
      <Slab min={[YARD.x0, 0, -0.1]} max={[GATE.x0 - 0.27, 1.6, 0.1]} m={MAT.matte("#6b6a66", 0.95)} />
      <Slab min={[GATE.x1 + 0.27, 0, -0.1]} max={[YARD.x1, 1.6, 0.1]} m={MAT.matte("#6b6a66", 0.95)} />
      {[0.12, 1.0, GATE.h - 0.05].map((y) => (
        <mesh key={y} geometry={box(GATE.x1 - GATE.x0, 0.04, 0.04, 0.005)} material={iron} position={[(GATE.x0 + GATE.x1) / 2, y, 0]} castShadow />
      ))}
      {Array.from({ length: n }, (_, k) => (
        <mesh key={k} geometry={cyl(0.012, 0.012, GATE.h - 0.05, 6)} material={iron} position={[GATE.x0 + ((k + 0.5) / n) * (GATE.x1 - GATE.x0), GATE.h / 2, 0]} castShadow />
      ))}
      {/* chain + padlock at the middle */}
      <mesh geometry={torus(0.07, 0.008, 6, 20)} material={MAT.steel()} position={[0, 1.0, 0.03]} rotation={[0.3, 0, 0.6]} />
      <mesh geometry={box(0.05, 0.06, 0.025, 0.01)} material={phys("brass", { color: "#a98a3e", metalness: 1, roughness: 0.35 })} position={[0.02, 0.93, 0.05]} castShadow />
    </group>
  );
};

export const Exterior: React.FC<{ visible: boolean; lamp: number; day?: boolean; roof?: boolean }> = ({ visible, lamp, day = false, roof = true }) => {
  const fx0 = ROOM.x0 - WALL, fx1 = -ROOM.x0 + WALL;
  return (
    <group visible={visible}>
      <Sky day={day} />
      {/* the lot under the building (seen in the overhead views) */}
      <Slab min={[YARD.x0 - 8, -0.16, -20]} max={[YARD.x1 + 8, -0.11, ENTRANCE_Z]} m={MAT.matte("#3b3934", 0.95)} cast={false} />
      {/* yard + street */}
      <Slab min={[YARD.x0 - 8, -0.12, ENTRANCE_Z]} max={[YARD.x1 + 8, -0.02, YARD.z1]} m={MAT.concrete([8, 4])} cast={false} />
      <Slab min={[-40, -0.14, YARD.z1]} max={[40, -0.04, YARD.z1 + 9]} m={MAT.matte("#2b2c2e", 0.9)} cast={false} />
      {/* terrace slab + roof + posts */}
      <Slab min={[fx0, -0.02, ENTRANCE_Z]} max={[fx1, 0.08, ENTRANCE_Z + 1.6]} m={MAT.tile([10, 2])} cast={false} />
      <Slab min={[fx0 - 0.2, CEIL + 0.1, ENTRANCE_Z]} max={[fx1 + 0.2, CEIL + 0.22, ENTRANCE_Z + 1.9]} m={MAT.matte("#9a978e", 0.9)} />
      {[fx0 + 0.3, fx1 - 0.3].map((x) => (
        <Slab key={x} min={[x - 0.1, 0, ENTRANCE_Z + 1.5]} max={[x + 0.1, CEIL + 0.1, ENTRANCE_Z + 1.7]} m={MAT.matte("#8d8a82", 0.9)} />
      ))}
      {/* front facade with two dark room windows */}
      {[[fx0, HALL.x0 - WALL], [HALL.x1 + WALL, fx1]].map(([a, b], i) => (
        <group key={i}>
          <Slab min={[a, 0, ENTRANCE_Z - 0.15]} max={[b, 0.95, ENTRANCE_Z]} m={MAT.matte("#8f8c84", 0.9)} />
          <Slab min={[a, 2.15, ENTRANCE_Z - 0.15]} max={[b, CEIL + 0.1, ENTRANCE_Z]} m={MAT.matte("#8f8c84", 0.9)} />
          <Slab min={[a, 0.95, ENTRANCE_Z - 0.15]} max={[a + 0.9, 2.15, ENTRANCE_Z]} m={MAT.matte("#8f8c84", 0.9)} />
          <Slab min={[b - 0.7, 0.95, ENTRANCE_Z - 0.15]} max={[b, 2.15, ENTRANCE_Z]} m={MAT.matte("#8f8c84", 0.9)} />
          <mesh geometry={box(b - a - 1.6, 1.2, 0.02, 0)} material={phys("darkGlass", { color: "#0b1018", roughness: 0.1, clearcoat: 1, metalness: 0.2 })} position={[(a + 0.9 + b - 0.7) / 2, 1.55, ENTRANCE_Z - 0.08]} />
        </group>
      ))}
      {/* roof: tiled pitch rising toward the back */}
      <group visible={roof}>
        <mesh geometry={box(fx1 - fx0 + 0.6, 0.12, 17.5, 0.01)} material={phys("roof", { color: "#5a3a2c", roughness: 0.8 })} position={[0, CEIL + 0.9, -7.0]} rotation={[0.1, 0, 0]} castShadow />
        <Slab min={[fx0, CEIL + 0.08, -15.2]} max={[fx1, CEIL + 0.45, ENTRANCE_Z]} m={MAT.matte("#b9b3a3", 0.95)} />
      </group>
      {/* terrace lamp (the one light still on) */}
      <group position={TERRACE_LAMP}>
        <mesh geometry={cyl(0.07, 0.05, 0.08, 16)} material={MAT.plastic("#e9e5dc")} position={[0, 0.06, 0]} />
        <mesh geometry={sphere(0.05, 16, 12)} material={phys(`bulb${lamp}`, { color: "#fff2dd", emissive: "#ffcf8a", emissiveIntensity: 6 * lamp })} />
      </group>
      <Scooter p={[-2.4, 0, 3.6]} yaw={0.15} c="#a8312c" />
      <Scooter p={[-3.5, 0, 3.4]} yaw={0.25} c="#1f3f6e" />
      <Gate />
      {/* street lamp beyond the gate */}
      <group position={[STREET_LAMP[0], 0, STREET_LAMP[2]]}>
        <mesh geometry={cyl(0.06, 0.08, STREET_LAMP[1], 10)} material={MAT.steel()} position={[0, STREET_LAMP[1] / 2, 0]} />
        <mesh geometry={box(0.5, 0.08, 0.2, 0.03)} material={MAT.steel()} position={[-0.25, STREET_LAMP[1], 0]} />
        <mesh geometry={box(0.3, 0.02, 0.14, 0.01)} material={basic("streetBulb", { color: "#ffd9a0" })} position={[-0.35, STREET_LAMP[1] - 0.05, 0]} />
      </group>
      {/* neighbour houses across the street + beside */}
      {[[-14, 12, 7, 4.6], [-5.5, 12, 6, 3.6], [3.5, 12, 7, 5.2], [12, 12, 6, 3.8], [-9.5, -4, 4, 3.4], [9.5, -6, 4, 3.8]].map(([x, z, w, h], i) => (
        <group key={i}>
          <Slab min={[x - w / 2, 0, z - 2.5]} max={[x + w / 2, h, z + 2.5]} m={MAT.matte(["#3c4150", "#4a4a52", "#3a4458"][i % 3], 0.95)} />
          <mesh geometry={box(w + 0.6, 0.1, 5.8, 0)} material={MAT.matte("#2a2224", 0.9)} position={[x, h + 0.25, z]} rotation={[0.18, 0, 0]} />
          {i === 2 ? <mesh geometry={box(0.8, 0.9, 0.01, 0)} material={basic("neighbourWin", { color: "#5b4a30" })} position={[x + 1.2, 1.6, z - 2.51]} /> : null}
        </group>
      ))}
      {/* a tree silhouette behind the side passage */}
      <group position={[-6.5, 0, -8]}>
        <mesh geometry={cyl(0.12, 0.18, 3.2, 8)} material={MAT.matte("#1f1a16", 0.9)} position={[0, 1.6, 0]} />
        {[[0, 3.8, 0, 1.8], [1, 3.2, 0.5, 1.3], [-1, 3.4, -0.4, 1.4]].map(([x, y, z, r], i) => (
          <mesh key={i} geometry={sphere(r, 12, 10)} material={MAT.matte("#141c18", 0.95)} position={[x, y, z]} castShadow />
        ))}
      </group>
      <mesh geometry={box(60, 30, 0.1, 0)} material={basic("horizonBack", { color: "#0c1324", side: DoubleSide, fog: false })} position={[0, 5, -60]} visible={false} />
    </group>
  );
};

==== 4725 project/src/worlds/kos/set/Gudang.tsx
// The gudang (storage room) behind the end wall — used for the "two people, same room" experiment.
// Same building: its door is the gudang door at the end of the hallway, its vent is the hallway vent.

import React from "react";
import { box, cyl, sphere, torus } from "../../../kits/worldforge/geo.ts";
import { basic, phys } from "../../../cine/mats.ts";
import { CEIL, END_Z, GUDANG, VENT, WALL } from "../layout.ts";
import { HoledWall, MAT, Slab } from "./parts.tsx";
import type { KosState } from "./Kos.tsx";

export const GUD = { x0: -0.95, x1: 1.75, z0: -18.2, z1: END_Z - WALL };
export const GUD_SWITCH: [number, number, number] = [GUDANG.x - GUDANG.w / 2 - 0.22, 1.3, GUD.z1 - 0.012];
export const GUD_BULB: [number, number, number] = [0.4, CEIL - 0.35, -16.7];

export const Gudang: React.FC<{ s: KosState }> = ({ s }) => {
  const wood = MAT.matte("#6b5440", 0.8);
  const card = (c: string) => MAT.matte(c, 0.9);
  const bulbOn = (s.gudang ?? 0) > 1.5 ? 1 : 0;
  return (
    <group>
      <Slab min={[GUD.x0, -0.1, GUD.z0]} max={[GUD.x1, 0, GUD.z1]} m={MAT.concrete([2, 2])} cast={false} />
      <group visible={s.roof !== false}>
        <Slab min={[GUD.x0, CEIL, GUD.z0]} max={[GUD.x1, CEIL + 0.08, GUD.z1]} m={MAT.matte("#8d8a80", 0.95)} />
      </group>
      <HoledWall axis="z" c={GUD.x0 - WALL / 2} a0={GUD.z1} a1={GUD.z0} holes={[]} dado={false} />
      <HoledWall axis="z" c={GUD.x1 + WALL / 2} a0={GUD.z1} a1={GUD.z0} holes={[]} dado={false} />
      <HoledWall axis="x" c={GUD.z0 - WALL / 2} a0={GUD.x0 - WALL} a1={GUD.x1 + WALL} holes={[{ a0: 0.2, a1: 1.0, y0: 1.5, y1: 2.2 }]} dado={false} />
      {/* back window glow + bars */}
      <mesh geometry={box(0.8, 0.7, 0.001, 0)} material={basic("gudWin", { color: "#26395c" })} position={[0.6, 1.85, GUD.z0 - 0.2]} />
      {[0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9].map((x) => (
        <mesh key={x} geometry={cyl(0.008, 0.008, 0.7, 6)} material={MAT.steel()} position={[x, 1.85, GUD.z0 - 0.05]} castShadow />
      ))}
      {/* shelves with boxes along the left wall */}
      {[0.35, 0.95, 1.55].map((y, i) => (
        <group key={y}>
          <Slab min={[GUD.x0, y - 0.02, -17.9]} max={[GUD.x0 + 0.45, y, -15.6]} m={wood} />
          {[0, 1, 2].map((k) => (
            <mesh key={k} geometry={box(0.36, 0.28 + 0.06 * ((i + k) % 2), 0.4 + 0.1 * (k % 2), 0.01)} material={card(["#a88a5e", "#8f7550", "#b49a6a"][(i + k) % 3])} position={[GUD.x0 + 0.22, y + 0.15, -17.5 + k * 0.7]} rotation={[0, (k - 1) * 0.06, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />
          ))}
        </group>
      ))}
      {[-17.9, -15.6].map((z) => (
        <Slab key={z} min={[GUD.x0, 0, z - 0.02]} max={[GUD.x0 + 0.45, 1.6, z + 0.02]} m={wood} />
      ))}
      {/* an old bicycle against the right wall */}
      <group position={[GUD.x1 - 0.25, 0, -17.0]} rotation={[0, Math.PI / 2, 0.06]}>
        {[-0.5, 0.5].map((z) => (
          <mesh key={z} geometry={torus(0.32, 0.02, 8, 36)} material={MAT.matte("#151515", 0.8)} position={[z, 0.34, 0]} castShadow />
        ))}
        <mesh geometry={cyl(0.015, 0.015, 1.0, 8)} material={MAT.matte("#7a2a24", 0.4)} position={[0, 0.62, 0]} rotation={[0, 0, Math.PI / 2 + 0.15]} castShadow />
        <mesh geometry={cyl(0.015, 0.015, 0.6, 8)} material={MAT.matte("#7a2a24", 0.4)} position={[-0.25, 0.5, 0]} rotation={[0, 0, 0.6]} castShadow />
        <mesh geometry={box(0.22, 0.05, 0.1, 0.02)} material={MAT.matte("#222", 0.6)} position={[-0.28, 0.82, 0]} castShadow />
      </group>
      {/* a rolled mattress, paint cans, a bucket */}
      <mesh geometry={cyl(0.22, 0.22, 0.9, 20)} material={phys("matt", { color: "#9aa6a0", roughness: 0.9 })} position={[1.2, 0.22, -15.8]} rotation={[0, 0, Math.PI / 2]} castShadow receiveShadow />
      {[0, 1, 2].map((k) => (
        <mesh key={k} geometry={cyl(0.1, 0.1, 0.22, 20)} material={phys(`can${k}`, { color: ["#c9c4b8", "#d8d0b0", "#b5bcc4"][k], metalness: 0.5, roughness: 0.4 })} position={[0.1 + k * 0.23, 0.11, -17.85]} castShadow />
      ))}
      {/* hanging bulb + switch by the door */}
      <mesh geometry={cyl(0.004, 0.004, 0.3, 6)} material={MAT.black()} position={[GUD_BULB[0], CEIL - 0.15, GUD_BULB[2]]} />
      <mesh geometry={sphere(0.045, 16, 12)} material={phys(`gbulb${bulbOn}`, { color: "#f5efe2", emissive: "#ffd9a0", emissiveIntensity: 5 * bulbOn, roughness: 0.3 })} position={GUD_BULB} />
      <mesh geometry={box(0.07, 0.11, 0.012, 0.004)} material={MAT.plastic("#efeee8")} position={GUD_SWITCH} />
      {/* the vent seen from inside (its flap faces the hallway) */}
      <mesh geometry={box(VENT.w + 0.06, VENT.y1 - VENT.y0 + 0.06, 0.02, 0.004)} material={MAT.frame()} position={[VENT.x, (VENT.y0 + VENT.y1) / 2, GUD.z1 - 0.01]} />
    </group>
  );
};

==== 10714 project/src/worlds/kos/set/Kos.tsx
// The kos building (one layout for the whole episode): hallway shell with room doors, breeze-block vents,
// ceiling tube lamps, conduit, CCTV at the entrance, everyday clutter (sandals, rack, chair, bin), the end
// of the hallway (End.tsx), the bedroom (Room.tsx), the outside (Exterior.tsx).

import React from "react";
import { box, cyl, sphere } from "../../../kits/worldforge/geo.ts";
import { basic, phys } from "../../../cine/mats.ts";
import { CCTV, CCTV_LOOK, CEIL, DOORS, END_Z, ENTRANCE_Z, HALL, LEFT_ROOMS_END, ROOM_DOOR, ROOM, SMALL_WIN, TUBES, WALL, type V3 } from "../layout.ts";
import { DoorSet, doorHoles, HoledWall, MAT, Slab } from "./parts.tsx";
import { End } from "./End.tsx";
import { Room } from "./Room.tsx";
import { Gudang } from "./Gudang.tsx";

export type KosState = {
  /** the bedroom (room 2) door open angle (rad, into the room) */
  roomDoor: number;
  /** key rotation 0..1 (locked at 1) */
  key: number;
  /** the bedroom door lever pressed 0..1 */
  lever: number;
  /** vent flap angle (rad) */
  vent: number;
  /** ceiling tubes 0..1 */
  tubes: number;
  /** CCTV LED 0..1 */
  led: number;
  /** clock colon on */
  colon: boolean;
  /** fan blade angle (rad) */
  fan: number;
  /** raincoat sway (rad) */
  coat: number;
  /** show the room interior / hallway (culling for speed) */
  room: boolean;
  hall: boolean;
  /** roofs + ceilings (off for the overhead "dollhouse" views) */
  roof?: boolean;
  /** gudang (storage room) interior */
  gudang?: number;
  /** clothes piled on the desk chair (pareidolia) */
  pile?: boolean;
  /** daylight outside the windows */
  day?: boolean;
  /** the raincoat hangs at the end of the hallway */
  coatOn?: boolean;
};

const LW = HALL.x0 - WALL / 2; // left wall centre
const RW = HALL.x1 + WALL / 2; // right wall centre

const Sandals: React.FC<{ p: V3; yaw: number; c: string }> = ({ p, yaw, c }) => (
  <group position={p} rotation={[0, yaw, 0]}>
    {[-0.07, 0.07].map((x, i) => (
      <group key={i} position={[x, 0, i * 0.04]} rotation={[0, (i - 0.5) * 0.18, 0]}>
        <mesh geometry={box(0.095, 0.016, 0.26, 0.008)} material={MAT.plastic(c)} position={[0, 0.008, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />
        {[1, -1].map((k) => (
          <mesh key={k} geometry={box(0.008, 0.01, 0.11, 0.004)} material={MAT.plastic("#e8e3d8")} position={[k * 0.028, 0.03, 0.03]} rotation={[0.22, k * 0.4, 0]} />
        ))}
      </group>
    ))}
  </group>
);

const Tube: React.FC<{ p: V3; on: number }> = ({ p, on }) => (
  <group position={p}>
    <mesh geometry={box(0.12, 0.05, 1.24, 0.01)} material={MAT.plastic("#e6e6e1")} castShadow />
    <mesh geometry={cyl(0.014, 0.014, 1.18, 12)} material={phys(`tube${on > 0.5}`, { color: "#dfe7ea", emissive: "#e8f4ff", emissiveIntensity: on * 1.25, roughness: 0.3 })} position={[0, -0.035, 0]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} />
  </group>
);

const Cctv: React.FC<{ led: number }> = ({ led }) => {
  const d = [CCTV_LOOK[0] - CCTV[0], CCTV_LOOK[1] - CCTV[1], CCTV_LOOK[2] - CCTV[2]];
  const yaw = Math.atan2(d[0], d[2]);
  const pitch = -Math.atan2(d[1], Math.hypot(d[0], d[2]));
  return (
    <group position={CCTV}>
      <mesh geometry={box(0.02, 0.1, 0.08, 0.006)} material={MAT.plastic("#ecebe6")} position={[HALL.x1 - CCTV[0] - 0.01, 0.05, 0]} />
      <mesh geometry={cyl(0.012, 0.012, HALL.x1 - CCTV[0], 10)} material={MAT.plastic("#ecebe6")} position={[(HALL.x1 - CCTV[0]) / 2, 0.06, 0]} rotation={[0, 0, Math.PI / 2]} />
      <group rotation={[pitch, yaw, 0]} rotation-order="YXZ">
        <mesh geometry={box(0.085, 0.08, 0.2, 0.02)} material={MAT.plastic("#5e5d58")} castShadow />
        <mesh geometry={box(0.1, 0.012, 0.23, 0.004)} material={MAT.plastic("#5e5d58")} position={[0, 0.046, 0.02]} />
        <mesh geometry={cyl(0.03, 0.03, 0.012, 24)} material={phys("lens", { color: "#05070a", roughness: 0.05, metalness: 0.3, clearcoat: 1 })} position={[0, 0, 0.102]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} />
        <mesh geometry={sphere(0.005, 10, 8)} material={basic(`led${led > 0.5}`, { color: led > 0.5 ? "#ff2a1a" : "#3a0806" })} position={[0.028, -0.026, 0.1]} />
      </group>
    </group>
  );
};

/** Plastic chair (kursi plastik) outside room 5. */
const Chair: React.FC<{ p: V3; yaw: number }> = ({ p, yaw }) => {
  const m = MAT.plastic("#2f6f9a");
  return (
    <group position={p} rotation={[0, yaw, 0]}>
      <mesh geometry={box(0.42, 0.04, 0.4, 0.03)} material={m} position={[0, 0.44, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />
      <mesh geometry={box(0.42, 0.4, 0.04, 0.03)} material={m} position={[0, 0.68, -0.2]} rotation={[-0.12, 0, 0]} castShadow />
      {[[-0.18, -0.17], [0.18, -0.17], [-0.18, 0.17], [0.18, 0.17]].map(([x, z], i) => (
        <mesh key={i} geometry={cyl(0.018, 0.024, 0.44, 10)} material={m} position={[x, 0.22, z]} rotation={[z * 0.3, 0, -x * 0.3]} castShadow />
      ))}
    </group>
  );
};

/** Hallway: floor, ceiling, both side walls with doors, entrance lintel, lamps, CCTV, clutter. */
export const Kos: React.FC<{ s: KosState }> = ({ s }) => {
  const len = ENTRANCE_Z - END_Z;
  const leftHoles = DOORS.filter((d) => d.side < 0).flatMap(doorHoles).concat([{ a0: SMALL_WIN.z0, a1: SMALL_WIN.z1, y0: SMALL_WIN.y0, y1: SMALL_WIN.y1 }]);
  const rightHoles = DOORS.filter((d) => d.side > 0).flatMap(doorHoles);
  return (
    <group>
      <group visible={s.hall}>
        {/* floor + ceiling */}
        <Slab min={[HALL.x0 - WALL, -0.1, END_Z - WALL]} max={[HALL.x1 + WALL, 0, ENTRANCE_Z]} m={MAT.tile([2, len / 0.8])} cast={false} />
        <group visible={s.roof !== false}>
          <Slab min={[HALL.x0 - WALL, CEIL, END_Z - WALL]} max={[HALL.x1 + WALL, CEIL + 0.08, ENTRANCE_Z]} m={MAT.ceil([1, len / 1.2])} />
        </group>
        {/* skirting */}
        {[HALL.x0 + 0.006, HALL.x1 - 0.006].map((x) => (
          <Slab key={x} min={[x - 0.006, 0, END_Z]} max={[x + 0.006, 0.09, ENTRANCE_Z]} m={MAT.trim()} cast={false} />
        ))}
        <HoledWall axis="z" c={LW} a0={ENTRANCE_Z} a1={END_Z} holes={leftHoles} />
        <HoledWall axis="z" c={RW} a0={ENTRANCE_Z} a1={END_Z} holes={rightHoles} />
        {/* entrance lintel (the hallway opens to the terrace) */}
        <Slab min={[HALL.x0 - WALL, 2.35, ENTRANCE_Z - 0.15]} max={[HALL.x1 + WALL, CEIL + 0.08, ENTRANCE_Z]} m={MAT.wall()} />
        {DOORS.map((d) => {
          const isRoom = d.id === ROOM_DOOR.id;
          return (
            <DoorSet
              key={d.id}
              d={d}
              wx={d.side < 0 ? LW : RW}
              open={isRoom ? s.roomDoor : 0}
              lever={isRoom ? s.lever : 0}
              lockKey={isRoom ? s.key : undefined}
              leaf={MAT.door(d.id === "K8" ? "dusty" : "std", d.id === "K8" ? "#4a3326" : undefined)}
              extra={
                d.id === "K8" ? (
                  // the empty room: a hasp and padlock on the hallway side
                  <group position={[RW - WALL / 2 - 0.03, 1.08, d.z - d.w / 2 + 0.07]}>
                    <mesh geometry={box(0.012, 0.03, 0.12, 0.004)} material={MAT.steel()} />
                    <mesh geometry={box(0.03, 0.05, 0.04, 0.008)} material={phys("brass", { color: "#a98a3e", metalness: 1, roughness: 0.35 })} position={[-0.02, -0.04, 0.03]} castShadow />
                  </group>
                ) : null
              }
            />
          );
        })}
        {/* conduit along the ceiling corner + switches beside each door */}
        <mesh geometry={cyl(0.012, 0.012, len, 8)} material={MAT.plastic("#e9e7e0")} position={[HALL.x1 - 0.03, CEIL - 0.03, (ENTRANCE_Z + END_Z) / 2]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} />
        {DOORS.map((d) => (
          <mesh key={`sw${d.id}`} geometry={box(0.012, 0.11, 0.07, 0.004)} material={MAT.plastic("#efeee8")} position={[(d.side < 0 ? HALL.x0 : HALL.x1) - d.side * 0.006, 1.35, d.z + d.w / 2 + 0.2]} />
        ))}
        {TUBES.map((p, i) => (
          <Tube key={i} p={p} on={s.tubes} />
        ))}
        <Cctv led={s.led} />
        {/* clutter */}
        <Sandals p={[HALL.x0 + 0.25, 0, ROOM_DOOR.z + 0.62]} yaw={1.3} c="#7b2a2a" />
        <Sandals p={[HALL.x1 - 0.24, 0, -3.5 + 0.6]} yaw={-1.7} c="#2a5b3c" />
        <Sandals p={[HALL.x1 - 0.22, 0, -10.5 - 0.62]} yaw={-1.45} c="#3a3a3a" />
        <Sandals p={[HALL.x0 + 0.22, 0, -9.0 + 0.6]} yaw={1.6} c="#b07a2a" />
        <Chair p={[HALL.x1 - 0.3, 0, -7.0 - 0.75]} yaw={-1.35} />
        {/* shoe rack by K1 */}
        <group position={[HALL.x0 + 0.17, 0, -0.4]}>
          {[0.08, 0.3, 0.52].map((y) => (
            <mesh key={y} geometry={box(0.3, 0.02, 0.8, 0.005)} material={MAT.matte("#4a3a2c", 0.6)} position={[0, y, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />
          ))}
          {[[-0.13, -0.38], [0.13, -0.38], [-0.13, 0.38], [0.13, 0.38]].map(([x, z], i) => (
            <mesh key={i} geometry={box(0.02, 0.56, 0.02, 0.004)} material={MAT.matte("#4a3a2c", 0.6)} position={[x, 0.28, z]} />
          ))}
          {[-0.22, 0.05, 0.27].map((z, i) => (
            <mesh key={z} geometry={box(0.11, 0.09, 0.27, 0.035)} material={MAT.matte(["#d8d2c6", "#2c2c30", "#8a5a3a"][i], 0.7)} position={[0, 0.35, z]} rotation={[0, 1.57, 0]} castShadow />
          ))}
        </group>
        {/* trash bin near the entrance */}
        <mesh geometry={cyl(0.17, 0.14, 0.48, 20)} material={MAT.plastic("#3e6b4c")} position={[HALL.x1 - 0.22, 0.24, 0.55]} castShadow receiveShadow />
      </group>
      {/* outer walls of both room blocks (keep the moon out except through real openings) */}
      <Slab min={[ROOM.x0 - WALL, 0, ROOM.z1 + WALL]} max={[ROOM.x0, CEIL + 0.1, ENTRANCE_Z]} m={MAT.matte("#9a978c", 0.95)} />
      <Slab min={[ROOM.x0 - WALL, 0, LEFT_ROOMS_END]} max={[ROOM.x0, CEIL + 0.1, ROOM.z0 - WALL]} m={MAT.matte("#9a978c", 0.95)} />
      <Slab min={[-ROOM.x0, 0, END_Z - WALL]} max={[-ROOM.x0 + WALL, CEIL + 0.1, ENTRANCE_Z]} m={MAT.matte("#9a978c", 0.95)} />
      <Slab min={[HALL.x1 + WALL, 0, END_Z - WALL]} max={[-ROOM.x0 + WALL, CEIL + 0.1, END_Z]} m={MAT.matte("#9a978c", 0.95)} />
      <group visible={s.roof !== false}>
        <Slab min={[ROOM.x0 - WALL, CEIL + 0.08, LEFT_ROOMS_END]} max={[-ROOM.x0 + WALL, CEIL + 0.2, ENTRANCE_Z]} m={MAT.matte("#8a877c", 0.95)} />
        <Slab min={[HALL.x0 - WALL, CEIL + 0.08, END_Z - WALL]} max={[-ROOM.x0 + WALL, CEIL + 0.2, LEFT_ROOMS_END]} m={MAT.matte("#8a877c", 0.95)} />
      </group>
      {/* left building block ends at LEFT_ROOMS_END: an exterior face toward the side passage */}
      <Slab min={[ROOM.x0 - WALL, 0, LEFT_ROOMS_END - WALL]} max={[HALL.x0 - WALL, 3.0, LEFT_ROOMS_END]} m={MAT.matte("#9a978c", 0.95)} />
      <Room s={s} />
      <End s={s} />
      {s.gudang ? <Gudang s={s} /> : null}
    </group>
  );
};

==== 8577 project/src/worlds/kos/set/parts.tsx
// Building blocks for the kos: axis-aligned slabs, walls with openings, door sets (frame, leaf, handle,
// number, breeze-block vent), shared materials. All geometry/materials cached by key.

import React from "react";
import { DoubleSide, type Material } from "three";
import { box, cyl, torus } from "../../../kits/worldforge/geo.ts";
import { basic, phys, tileTex } from "../../../cine/mats.ts";
import { ceilTex, concreteTex, doorTex, numberTex, plasterTex, rosterTex } from "../../../cine/set/tex.ts";
import { CEIL, WALL, type Door, type V3 } from "../layout.ts";

export const MAT = {
  wall: () => phys("wallUp", { color: "#d3cdbb", roughness: 0.92, map: plasterTex("up", [1, 1], 0.12) }),
  dado: () => phys("dado", { color: "#5d7a74", roughness: 0.55, map: plasterTex("dado", [1, 1], 0.3), clearcoat: 0.15 }),
  trim: () => phys("trim", { color: "#3c4b47", roughness: 0.5 }),
  ceil: (rep: [number, number]) => phys(`ceil${rep}`, { color: "#d9d9d4", roughness: 0.95, map: ceilTex(rep) }),
  tile: (rep: [number, number]) => phys(`tile${rep}`, { color: "#ffffff", map: tileTex(rep), roughness: 0.34, clearcoat: 0.18, clearcoatRoughness: 0.45 }),
  frame: () => phys("frame", { color: "#3a2416", roughness: 0.5, clearcoat: 0.3 }),
  door: (key: string, base?: string) => phys(`door${key}`, { color: "#ffffff", map: doorTex(key, base), roughness: 0.42, clearcoat: 0.45, clearcoatRoughness: 0.3 }),
  chrome: () => phys("chrome", { color: "#c9ccd1", metalness: 1, roughness: 0.22 }),
  steel: () => phys("steel", { color: "#55585e", metalness: 0.8, roughness: 0.45 }),
  roster: () => phys("roster", { color: "#c9c4b4", roughness: 0.9, alphaMap: rosterTex(), alphaTest: 0.5, side: DoubleSide }),
  concrete: (rep: [number, number]) => phys(`concrete${rep}`, { color: "#ffffff", map: concreteTex(rep), roughness: 0.95 }),
  plastic: (c: string) => phys(`plastic${c}`, { color: c, roughness: 0.45, clearcoat: 0.2 }),
  matte: (c: string, r = 0.85) => phys(`matte${c}${r}`, { color: c, roughness: r }),
  black: () => basic("black", { color: "#000000" }),
  number: (label: string) => phys(`num${label}`, { color: "#ffffff", map: numberTex(label), roughness: 0.6 }),
};

/** Axis-aligned slab from min to max corner. */
export const Slab: React.FC<{ min: V3; max: V3; m: Material; r?: number; cast?: boolean; recv?: boolean }> = ({ min, max, m, r = 0.004, cast = true, recv = true }) => {
  const w = max[0] - min[0], h = max[1] - min[1], d = max[2] - min[2];
  if (w <= 0 || h <= 0 || d <= 0) return null;
  return (
    <mesh
      geometry={box(+w.toFixed(4), +h.toFixed(4), +d.toFixed(4), r, 1)}
      material={m}
      position={[(min[0] + max[0]) / 2, (min[1] + max[1]) / 2, (min[2] + max[2]) / 2]}
      castShadow={cast}
      receiveShadow={recv}
    />
  );
};

export type Hole = { a0: number; a1: number; y0: number; y1: number };

/**
 * A wall along an axis with rectangular openings. `axis` "z": the wall runs along z at x = c (thickness
 * across x); "x": runs along x at z = c. Upper paint + lower dado band (1.0 m) on both faces.
 */
export const HoledWall: React.FC<{ axis: "x" | "z"; c: number; a0: number; a1: number; holes: Hole[]; t?: number; top?: number; dado?: boolean }> = ({ axis, c, a0, a1, holes, t = WALL, top = CEIL, dado = true }) => {
  const lo = Math.min(a0, a1), hi = Math.max(a0, a1);
  const hs = [...holes].sort((p, q) => Math.min(p.a0, p.a1) - Math.min(q.a0, q.a1)).map((h) => ({ ...h, a0: Math.min(h.a0, h.a1), a1: Math.max(h.a0, h.a1) }));
  const pieces: { a0: number; a1: number; y0: number; y1: number }[] = [];
  let cur = lo;
  for (const h of hs) {
    if (h.a0 > cur) pieces.push({ a0: cur, a1: h.a0, y0: 0, y1: top });
    if (h.y0 > 0) pieces.push({ a0: h.a0, a1: h.a1, y0: 0, y1: h.y0 });
    if (h.y1 < top) pieces.push({ a0: h.a0, a1: h.a1, y0: h.y1, y1: top });
    cur = Math.max(cur, h.a1);
  }
  if (cur < hi) pieces.push({ a0: cur, a1: hi, y0: 0, y1: top });
  const DADO = 1.0;
  const out: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  pieces.forEach((p, i) => {
    const mk = (y0: number, y1: number, m: Material, k: string, inset = 0) => {
      if (y1 <= y0) return;
      const min: V3 = axis === "z" ? [c - t / 2 - inset, y0, p.a0] : [p.a0, y0, c - t / 2 - inset];
      const max: V3 = axis === "z" ? [c + t / 2 + inset, y1, p.a1] : [p.a1, y1, c + t / 2 + inset];
      out.push(<Slab key={`${i}${k}`} min={min} max={max} m={m} />);
    };
    if (dado && p.y0 < DADO) {
      mk(p.y0, Math.min(DADO, p.y1), MAT.dado(), "d", 0.004);
      mk(Math.max(DADO, p.y0), p.y1, MAT.wall(), "u");
      if (p.y1 > DADO) mk(DADO - 0.012, DADO + 0.012, MAT.trim(), "t", 0.008);
    } else mk(p.y0, p.y1, MAT.wall(), "u");
  });
  return <>{out}</>;
};

/** Holes for a hallway door + its breeze-block vent above. */
export const doorHoles = (d: Door): Hole[] => [{ a0: d.z - d.w / 2 - 0.06, a1: d.z + d.w / 2 + 0.06, y0: 0, y1: 2.5 }];

/**
 * A complete door set in a side wall at x = wx (wall centre): frame, leaf (open angle `open`, swinging
 * into the room, i.e. away from the hallway), lever handles both sides, number plate, breeze-block vent.
 */
export const DoorSet: React.FC<{ d: Door; wx: number; open?: number; leaf: Material; extra?: React.ReactNode; lever?: number; lockKey?: number }> = ({ d, wx, open = 0, leaf, extra, lever = 0, lockKey }) => {
  const s = d.side; // −1 left wall, +1 right wall
  const z0 = d.z - d.w / 2, z1 = d.z + d.w / 2;
  const fw = 0.06, depth = WALL + 0.03;
  const hingeZ = d.hinge > 0 ? z1 : z0;
  const latchDir = d.hinge > 0 ? -1 : 1; // from hinge toward the latch along z
  // leaf swings into the room: rotate about y at the hinge; positive angle for a left-wall door moves −x
  const ang = open * (s < 0 ? 1 : -1) * (d.hinge > 0 ? 1 : -1);
  const fr = MAT.frame();
  return (
    <group>
      <Slab min={[wx - depth / 2, 0, z0 - fw]} max={[wx + depth / 2, d.h + fw, z0]} m={fr} />
      <Slab min={[wx - depth / 2, 0, z1]} max={[wx + depth / 2, d.h + fw, z1 + fw]} m={fr} />
      <Slab min={[wx - depth / 2, d.h, z0 - fw]} max={[wx + depth / 2, d.h + fw, z1 + fw]} m={fr} />
      {/* lintel + breeze-block vent above the door */}
      <Slab min={[wx - WALL / 2, d.h + fw, z0 - fw]} max={[wx + WALL / 2, 2.2, z1 + fw]} m={MAT.wall()} />
      <Slab min={[wx - depth / 2, 2.2, z0 - fw]} max={[wx + depth / 2, 2.22, z1 + fw]} m={fr} />
      <Slab min={[wx - depth / 2, 2.48, z0 - fw]} max={[wx + depth / 2, 2.5, z1 + fw]} m={fr} />
      {[-0.06, 0.06].map((o) => (
        <mesh key={o} geometry={box(0.001, 0.26, d.w + 2 * fw, 0)} material={MAT.roster()} position={[wx + o, 2.35, d.z]} castShadow />
      ))}
      {/* leaf, pivoting at the hinge */}
      <group position={[wx + s * 0.02, 0, hingeZ]} rotation={[0, ang, 0]}>
        <group position={[0, 0, latchDir * d.w / 2]}>
          <Slab min={[-0.02, 0.01, -d.w / 2 + 0.005]} max={[0.02, d.h - 0.005, d.w / 2 - 0.005]} m={leaf} r={0.006} />
          {[1, -1].map((side) => (
            <group key={side} position={[side * 0.026, 1.0, latchDir * (d.w / 2 - 0.085)]}>
              <mesh geometry={box(0.012, 0.16, 0.045, 0.006)} material={MAT.chrome()} castShadow />
              <group position={[side * 0.025, 0.03, 0]} rotation={[-latchDir * lever, 0, 0]}>
                <mesh geometry={cyl(0.009, 0.009, 0.11, 12)} material={MAT.chrome()} position={[0, 0, -latchDir * 0.045]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} castShadow />
              </group>
              <mesh geometry={cyl(0.007, 0.007, 0.012, 10)} material={MAT.steel()} position={[side * 0.004, -0.045, 0]} rotation={[0, 0, Math.PI / 2]} />
            </group>
          ))}
          <mesh geometry={box(0.004, 0.09, 0.09, 0.002)} material={MAT.number(d.label)} position={[-s * 0.024, 1.62, 0]} />
          {lockKey !== undefined ? (
            // key in the lock on the room side (turns a quarter to lock)
            <group position={[s * 0.03, 0.955, latchDir * (d.w / 2 - 0.085)]} rotation={[lockKey * Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]}>
              <mesh geometry={box(0.012, 0.008, 0.008, 0.002)} material={phys("keyBrass", { color: "#b8973f", metalness: 1, roughness: 0.3 })} position={[s * 0.006, 0, 0]} />
              <mesh geometry={box(0.004, 0.028, 0.022, 0.003)} material={phys("keyBrass", { color: "#b8973f", metalness: 1, roughness: 0.3 })} position={[s * 0.016, 0, 0]} castShadow />
              <mesh geometry={torus(0.005, 0.0015, 6, 12)} material={MAT.steel()} position={[s * 0.016, 0.018, 0]} rotation={[0, Math.PI / 2, 0]} />
            </group>
          ) : null}
        </group>
      </group>
      {extra}
    </group>
  );
};

const Bed: React.FC = () => {

        ))}

        <mesh geometry={box(0.44, 0.32, 0.05, 0.03)} material={phys("shirtChair", { color: "#ffffff", map: weaveTex("shirtC", "#2e3240", [4, 4]), roughness: 0.9 })} position={[0, 0.78, -0.2]} rotation={[0.1, 0, 0.03]} castShadow />
      </group>
    </group>
  );
};

/** Clothes on hooks beside the door (a jacket and a towel). */
const Hooks: React.FC = () => (
  <group position={[IN_X1 - 0.01, 1.72, -4.25]}>

    <mesh geometry={box(0.06, 0.55, 0.24, 0.03)} material={phys("towel", { color: "#ffffff", map: weaveTex("towel", "#c9b9a0", [6, 6]), roughness: 0.95, sheen: 0.6 })} position={[-0.04, -0.3, -0.2]} castShadow />
  </group>
);

const Window: React.FC<{ s: KosState }> = ({ s }) => {
  const x = ROOM.x0 - WALL / 2, zc = (ROOM_WIN.z0 + ROOM_WIN.z1) / 2, yc = (ROOM_WIN.y0 + ROOM_WIN.y1) / 2;
  const w = ROOM_WIN.z1 - ROOM_WIN.z0, h = ROOM_WIN.y1 - ROOM_WIN.y0;
  const fr = MAT.frame();
  const curtain = phys("curtain", { color: "#ffffff", map: weaveTex("curtain", "#3e5a74", [3, 3]), roughness: 0.95, side: DoubleSide, sheen: 0.5 });
  return (
    <group>
      <group position={[x, yc, zc]}>
        <Slab min={[-0.09, -h / 2 - 0.05, -w / 2 - 0.05]} max={[0.09, -h / 2, w / 2 + 0.05]} m={fr} />
        <Slab min={[-0.09, h / 2, -w / 2 - 0.05]} max={[0.09, h / 2 + 0.05, w / 2 + 0.05]} m={fr} />
        <Slab min={[-0.09, -h / 2, -w / 2 - 0.05]} max={[0.09, h / 2, -w / 2]} m={fr} />
        <Slab min={[-0.09, -h / 2, w / 2]} max={[0.09, h / 2, w / 2 + 0.05]} m={fr} />
        <Slab min={[-0.09, -0.02, -w / 2]} max={[0.09, 0.02, w / 2]} m={fr} />
        <Slab min={[-0.09, -h / 2, -0.02]} max={[0.09, h / 2, 0.02]} m={fr} />
        <mesh geometry={box(0.004, h, w, 0)} material={phys("glass", { color: "#9fb4c8", roughness: 0.08, transparent: true, opacity: 0.18, depthWrite: false })} />
        {/* night outside: a neighbour wall + sky glow */}
        <mesh geometry={box(0.001, 2.4, 3.2, 0)} material={s.day ? basic("roomSkyDay", { color: "#dbe6ee", side: DoubleSide }) : basic("roomSky", { color: "#14223c", side: DoubleSide })} position={[-1.6, 0.4, 0]} />
      </group>
      {/* curtains: one drawn, one gathered */}
      {Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, k) => (
        <mesh key={k} geometry={cyl(0.035, 0.035, h + 0.35, 10, true)} material={curtain} position={[x + 0.12 + (k % 2) * 0.02, yc + 0.12, ROOM_WIN.z0 - 0.08 + k * 0.07]} castShadow />
      ))}
      {Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, k) => (
        <mesh key={`g${k}`} geometry={cyl(0.04, 0.04, h + 0.35, 10, true)} material={curtain} position={[x + 0.13 + (k % 2) * 0.03, yc + 0.12, ROOM_WIN.z1 + 0.08 - k * 0.05]} castShadow />
      ))}
      <mesh geometry={cyl(0.01, 0.01, w + 0.8, 8)} material={MAT.chrome()} position={[x + 0.14, ROOM_WIN.y1 + 0.32, (ROOM_WIN.z0 + ROOM_WIN.z1) / 2]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} />
    </group>
  );
};

/** A pile of clothes over the desk chair: in the dark it reads as someone sitting (pareidolia). */
const Pile: React.FC = () => {

==== 1720 project/src/worlds/studio/data.ts
// Studio places available in EVERY world (for the explanation passages): "mind" — a deep-blue neural
// space with the glass brain from Dunia Nabel EP01. Far away from every set, never shares a frame with it.

import { P_OFF, S_OFF, type LightState } from "../../cine/types.ts";
import type { Place, V3 } from "../types.ts";

export const MIND_O: V3 = [0, 0, 500];
const add = (a: V3, b: V3): V3 => [a[0] + b[0], a[1] + b[1], a[2] + b[2]];

const mind: Place = {
  id: "mind", doc: "studio: the glass brain floating in a deep-blue neural space (any world) — for explaining perception, memory, fear",
  kind: "studio", floor: MIND_O[1],
  marks: {},
  pois: { brain: MIND_O, front: add(MIND_O, [0, 0.1, 0.9]), top: add(MIND_O, [0, 0.8, 0]), back: add(MIND_O, [0, 0.1, -0.9]), left: add(MIND_O, [-0.9, 0, 0]), right: add(MIND_O, [0.9, 0, 0]) },
  box: { min: add(MIND_O, [-12, -6, -12]), max: add(MIND_O, [12, 8, 12]) },
  solids: [{ min: add(MIND_O, [-1.1, -0.9, -1.1]), max: add(MIND_O, [1.1, 1.0, 1.1]) }],
  establish: { center: MIND_O, radius: 4.2, height: 0.8, yaw: 0.6 },
  view: "brain", ambience: "studio", surface: "carpet", reverb: 0.6,
};

export const STUDIO: Record<string, Place> = { mind };

export const studioLight = (): LightState => ({
  bg: "#061426", fog: { color: "#061426", density: 0.0 }, env: 0.25,
  hemi: { sky: "#6fa8d8", ground: "#0b1a2c", i: 0.5 },
  moon: { dir: [0.3, 0.8, 0.5], color: "#cfe6ff", i: 1.6, box: { min: add(MIND_O, [-4, -3, -4]), max: add(MIND_O, [4, 4, 4]) } },
  spots: [S_OFF, S_OFF],
  pts: [{ pos: add(MIND_O, [0, 1.5, 3]), color: "#8fdcff", i: 3, dist: 9 }, { pos: add(MIND_O, [-2.5, 0.5, 1]), color: "#ffbf73", i: 1.6, dist: 7 }, P_OFF, P_OFF, P_OFF, P_OFF],
});

==== 4460 project/src/worlds/types.ts
// World contract (data side). A world = one consistent place made of named sub-locations ("places").
// Stories only ever name places, marks (where people stand/sit), POIs (what they look at) and set props
// (things that change: lamps, doors, a light at sea). Everything here is plain data + pure functions,
// importable by the director and the sound script (no JSX).

import type { LightState, V3 } from "../cine/types.ts";

export type { V3 };
export type Box = { min: V3; max: V3 };
export type Surface = "grass" | "wood" | "tile" | "stone" | "sand" | "metal" | "carpet";

/** A spot a person can stand at. `yaw` = facing (0 = +z), `seat` = seat height (sit), `bed` = lie here. */
export type Mark = { p: [number, number]; y?: number; yaw?: number; seat?: number; bed?: { head: [number, number]; y: number }; doc?: string };

export type Place = {
  id: string;
  doc: string;
  kind: "interior" | "exterior" | "studio";
  /** floor height under the people standing here */
  floor: number;
  marks: Record<string, Mark>;
  pois: Record<string, V3>;
  /** cameras are clamped into `box` and pushed out of every solid */
  box: Box;
  /** generated interiors: the camera must also be inside one of these (the rooms of the place) */
  zones?: Box[];
  /** walls etc. that block the view (line-of-sight checks only) */
  occluders?: Box[];
  solids: Box[];
  /** foliage (tree crowns, bushes): cameras are kept out, the view may pass through */
  soft?: Box[];
  /** the swing of every door leaf (cameras keep off it like off a solid; a shut door is air, so only a small margin) */
  swings?: Box[];
  /** ground height for cameras (exteriors with terrain) */
  ground?: (x: number, z: number) => number;
  /** hint for establishing shots: what to frame and from how far */
  establish: { center: V3; radius: number; height: number; yaw: number };
  /** the default looking direction for wides (a POI name) */
  view: string;
  /** interiors: a window POI to shoot far things through (long lens from just outside it) */
  window?: string;
  ambience: string;
  surface: Surface;
  /** 0 dry … 1 big hall (sound reverb) */
  reverb: number;
};

export type PropDoc = { default: number; doc: string; sfx?: { up?: string; down?: string } };
export type SetState = Record<string, number>;

export type WorldData = {
  id: string;
  doc: string;
  places: Record<string, Place>;
  times: string[];
  props: Record<string, PropDoc>;
  /** light rig for a place at a time of day, given the set state */
  light: (place: string, time: string, s: SetState, t: number) => LightState;
};

export const inBox = (p: V3, b: Box, m = 0) => p[0] > b.min[0] - m && p[0] < b.max[0] + m && p[1] > b.min[1] - m && p[1] < b.max[1] + m && p[2] > b.min[2] - m && p[2] < b.max[2] + m;

/** Keep a camera position legal for a place: inside its box, out of solids, above the ground. */
export const legalCam = (pl: Place, p: V3): V3 => {
  const q: V3 = [
    Math.min(pl.box.max[0], Math.max(pl.box.min[0], p[0])),
    Math.min(pl.box.max[1], Math.max(pl.box.min[1], p[1])),
    Math.min(pl.box.max[2], Math.max(pl.box.min[2], p[2])),
  ];
  if (pl.zones?.length && !pl.zones.some((z) => inBox(q, z))) {
    // pull into the nearest room
    let best = q, bd = Infinity;
    for (const z of pl.zones) {
      const c: V3 = [Math.min(z.max[0], Math.max(z.min[0], q[0])), Math.min(z.max[1], Math.max(z.min[1], q[1])), Math.min(z.max[2], Math.max(z.min[2], q[2]))];
      const d = Math.hypot(c[0] - q[0], c[1] - q[1], c[2] - q[2]);
      if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = c; }
    }
    q[0] = best[0]; q[1] = best[1]; q[2] = best[2];
  }
  // solids keep 12 cm off the lens; foliage (irregular, bigger than its box) half a metre
  for (const [s, m] of [...pl.solids.map((b) => [b, 0.12] as const), ...(pl.swings ?? []).map((b) => [b, 0.12] as const), ...(pl.soft ?? []).map((b) => [b, 0.5] as const)]) {
    if (!inBox(q, s, m)) continue;
    // push out through the nearest face
    const d = [q[0] - (s.min[0] - m), s.max[0] + m - q[0], q[1] - (s.min[1] - m), s.max[1] + m - q[1], q[2] - (s.min[2] - m), s.max[2] + m - q[2]];
    const k = d.indexOf(Math.min(...d));
    if (k === 0) q[0] = s.min[0] - m; else if (k === 1) q[0] = s.max[0] + m;
    else if (k === 2) q[1] = s.min[1] - m; else if (k === 3) q[1] = s.max[1] + m;
    else if (k === 4) q[2] = s.min[2] - m; else q[2] = s.max[2] + m;
  }
  if (pl.ground) q[1] = Math.max(q[1], pl.ground(q[0], q[2]) + 0.35);
  return q;
};
